d: Rapidus Logistics FZCO is a Dubai-based logistics company specializing in fast, reliable, and tightly controlled freight solutions, with a strong focus on air freight and time-critical shipments.
q: Candidates should possess strong core accounting skills, including general ledger management, accounts payable/receivable, bank reconciliation, and financial reporting.
Candidates should possess skills in budgeting, cost control, and variance analysis to support decision-making and operational efficiency.
Candidates should possess proficiency with accounting software and Excel, including the ability to work with spreadsheets, financial models, and data analysis tools.
Candidates should possess knowledge of applicable accounting standards, tax regulations, and audit processes relevant to the UAE or international logistics operations.
Candidates should possess strong numerical aptitude, attention to detail, and the ability to work accurately with tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Candidates should possess effective communication and collaboration skills to work with finance, operations, and management teams, and maintain clear documentation.
Relevant qualifications such as a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field are preferred; professional certifications (e.g., ACCA, CPA, CMA) are an advantage.
Prior experience in logistics, freight forwarding, or a similar industry is beneficial, along with familiarity with cost allocation for shipments and operational activities.
r: The Accountant at Rapidus Logistics FZCO will handle the day-to-day financial operations, including recording transactions, maintaining general ledgers, preparing invoices, and managing accounts payable and receivable. The role involves reconciling bank statements, assisting with monthly and annual closings, and ensuring accurate, timely financial reporting that supports operational decision-making. The Accountant will also monitor budgets, support audit requirements, and ensure compliance with relevant accounting standards and local regulations. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Dubai, working closely with operations and management teams to support cost control and financial transparency.
